name: Clover plain-message routing benchmark v1
written: 2026-11-09, before any engine run on it

rules.act: Everything needed is in the message or is general knowledge, and doing it changes nothing outside the reply (or the change asked for is fully specified and harmless).
rules.gather: The request is clear and safe, but the answer depends on the user's files, accounts, devices, logs or live data that the message does not contain; reading them is the next step.
rules.clarify: Something only the user can supply is missing (which item, target, value, person or place), or the request is destructive or high-impact without a clear target.
rules.verify: The message relays a claim (from a person, app, tool, document or an earlier answer) that the next step depends on and that has not been checked against evidence.
rules.precedence: clarify > verify > gather > act: a missing detail only the user can give comes first; then an unchecked claim the next step relies on; then unread data; otherwise act.
rules.hard_negatives: act tasks include destructive verbs applied only to text in the message (a13, a43, a48), a general-knowledge claim to check (a17) and a mistake to find (a28); gather tasks ask for data without any claim.
